name: Jotunheim
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card after you activate a system. During the "Movement" step of this tactical action, other players cannot use SPACE CANNON against your ships.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: Rock and rubble gives them trouble.
flavourText: A rocky desert planet, once mined for a special ore. Now the debris ridden land is almost useless. Almost.
